rationale: The agent did not demonstrate required authentication beyond looking up user IDs by email. It executed order-changing actions (cancelling two pending orders and initiating a return) without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy. It also did not handle the user’s conditional request to exchange the boots only if a cheaper identical pair exists, nor did it provide a final calculation of how much money the user would get back today. The closing message contained no refund totals or confirmation details. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
